selection: Next ordinal after 01, fixed in the previous next-step plan before full selected reference parsing; not selected by score.
reference_exposure: All eight member prefixes were exposed previously. Any later comparison remains exploratory; no blind/held-out claim.
boundary: Do not open or parse the reference archive in acquisition or input inspection. No estimator, parameter search, clock/extrinsic fitting or score in this stage.
coverage: Use every original scan in chronological order; report exact header/point/IMU times and coverage before defining a new estimator cohort. Preserve uncovered scans as labelled exclusions.
overwrite_policy: Exclusive creation only. Preserve failed/partial downloads under distinct attempt paths.
source_policy: Save author pages/paper, manufacturer SDK/driver and author configuration evidence with retrieval time, byte hash and immutable repository commit where available. A generic SDK/config is not proof of the recording producer build or calibration.
